title: Rabbit Horoscope 2027: What the Fire Goat Year Means for the Rabbit
seo_title: Rabbit Horoscope 2027: Chinese Zodiac Forecast for the Year of the Goat
description: How the Rabbit is traditionally read in 2027, the Fire Goat year: the Rabbit's relationship with the Goat, your element by birth year, love and work, the months to watch, and lucky colors and numbers.
lead: Good news for the Rabbit: 2027, the Fire Goat year, is traditionally one of its friendlier years, because the Rabbit and the Goat share a triangle. Here is how the Rabbit is read in 2027, what your birth element adds, and the months to watch.
card_text: The Rabbit in the 2027 Fire Goat year: love, work, your element by birth year and the months to watch.

sections.h2: The Rabbit and the Goat year
paras: The Rabbit, the Goat and the Pig form one of the zodiac's four triangles of signs that traditionally get on well. A year ruled by your triangle partner is read as supportive: things tend to flow more easily and people are more willing to help.

A calm, creative Goat year suits the Rabbit's love of harmony. The Rabbit's watch-out is avoiding hard conversations; a supportive year is a good time to say what needs saying, gently, before small problems grow.
after: 2027 is a Ding-wei year, according to the Hong Kong Observatory: Ding is a Fire stem and Wei is the Goat, so it is the year of the Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027 to 25 January 2028. These are cultural readings, not forecasts: no evidence shows a year's animal decides anyone's luck. Use them as a prompt to think about your own plans.

Born in January or early February? The zodiac year starts at Chinese New Year, so check the start date in the table; if you were born before it, you belong to the sign before the Rabbit. Our born in January guide and the zodiac checker explain.

sections.h2: Love and relationships for the Rabbit
paras: The Rabbit's natural matches in our guide are the Goat and the Pig, its triangle partners, and the Dog. With the Goat ruling the year, tradition reads 2027 as a warm year for relationships: a good time to deepen a bond or to meet people through friends. The Rooster, the Rabbit's opposite, is the pairing tradition marks as the hardest.

sections.h2: Work and money for the Rabbit
paras: Our guide links the Rabbit with diplomacy, counseling, design and hospitality, work that needs a careful, caring touch, which is exactly what a Goat year is said to reward. A friendly year is a good time to ask for the opportunity you want rather than wait to be noticed. With money, the Rabbit's caution is sensible; the risk is being too cautious to act on a good idea.

Each zodiac year is also divided into twelve zodiac months. Each one starts at a solar term rather than at the new moon, beginning with the Tiger month at Spring Commences (Lichun) on 4 February 2027. sections.h2: Lucky colors, numbers and days for the Rabbit
paras: In our Rabbit guide, the Rabbit's lucky colors are pink, red, purple, its lucky numbers are 3, 4, 6, and its lucky days are Monday and Thursday. For the full profile, read the Year of the Rabbit guide; for every sign in 2027, see the 2027 predictions.

faq: Is 2027 a good year for the Rabbit?
Yes, traditionally: the Rabbit shares the Goat's triangle (Rabbit, Goat and Pig), so 2027 is read as one of its friendlier years.
What is the Rabbit's clash month in 2027?
The Rooster month, from 8 Sep to 7 Oct 2027. The Rooster is the Rabbit's opposite sign, and tradition marks its month as the one to take extra care in.
What element is my Rabbit year?

It depends on the year you were born: 1939 is an Earth Rabbit; 1951 is a Metal Rabbit; 1963 is a Water Rabbit; 1975 is a Wood Rabbit; 1987 is a Fire Rabbit; 1999 is an Earth Rabbit; 2011 is a Metal Rabbit; 2023 is a Water Rabbit.
What are the Rabbit's lucky colors and numbers?
In our Rabbit guide: colors pink, red, purple; numbers 3, 4, 6; days Monday and Thursday.
